2113259508231536768.en_summary: @ripster47 plan for $SPY, $QQQ and $SPX: VIX 18 is key again, with no longs on the market under the 34/50 clouds or if VIX holds 18; watch SOXL and oil, look for curls if semis bounce with a VIX 18 break, and watch the 10 AM and 10:40 algo moves.
2113259508231536768.zh_summary: @ripster47 對 $SPY、$QQQ 與 $SPX 的當日計劃：VIX 18 再次關鍵，若大盤低於 34/50 雲帶或 VIX 守住 18 便不做多；留意 SOXL 與油價，若半導體反彈且 VIX 跌破 18 可留意回升形態，並注意上午 10 時與 10 時 40 分的演算法走勢。
